description: This line plot compares the accuracy (%) of four different methods—“Ours (Dynamic Seg)”, “Ours (Static 4-Seg)”, “PLLaVA (DP 8)”, and “PLLaVA (DP 16)” — as a function of the “Number of Frames”, which ranges from 10 to 60 on a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, spans from 40% to 54% and is also linearly scaled. The “Ours (Dynamic Seg)” method is represented by a blue line with circular markers, starting at approximately 53% accuracy at 10 frames and ending at approximately 53.5% at 60 frames, showing a slight upward trend. The “Ours (Static 4-Seg)” method is represented by a green line with circular markers, beginning at approximately 52.5% accuracy at 10 frames and remaining nearly constant at approximately 53.7% until 60 frames. The “PLLaVA (DP 8)” method is shown by an orange line with square markers, starting at approximately 45.5% accuracy at 10 frames and steadily declining to approximately 39.5% at 60 frames. The “PLLaVA (DP 16)” method is depicted by a red line with square markers, beginning at approximately 45.7% accuracy at 10 frames and decreasing to approximately 42.2% at 60 frames.
